No triggers or foreign keys disabled. Measured confirmations use normal production posting.

scope: Hot serial reads, then 3 concurrent report clients (separate keep-alive connections, fired together per round), before measured writes. The capacity fixture carries 200,000 settlements (average 2 per invoice item, 20% fully settled) plus 2,500 cancellations and 2,500 advance+apply adjustments (5% of invoices adjusted), loaded directly with triggers and foreign keys enabled. Reports include all-party aggregation, not only page SQL. AP PO-matched/AR invoices each have 100 VAT lines and 100 distinct dimension segments. Fresh copy of identical synthetic fixture and a new production child per repeat.
